name: code-narration
description: LLM-powered narration of code and diffs in a side pane.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace, narration commands stay disabled because the file's contents (and, in tree mode, every changed file in the repo) are forwarded to a third-party language model. Trust the workspace to enable narration.

codeNarration.provider.description: Which language model provider to use. 'vscodeLm' uses the built-in VS Code Language Model API (requires GitHub Copilot). 'anthropic' calls the Anthropic API directly using a key stored in SecretStorage.

codeNarration.vscodeLm.modelFamily.description: Optional model family for the VS Code LM provider (e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'claude-sonnet-4'). Empty picks the first available model.

codeNarration.anthropic.model.description: Anthropic model ID. Examples: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-7, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.

codeNarration.persona.markdownDescription:
Active narration persona. Each persona reuses the same output formatting rules but applies a different review lens.

Built-in ids: `default`, `critical`, `security`, `performance`, `tests`, `onboarding`, `refactor-scout`, `doc-comment-writer`, `accessibility-reviewer`, `cost-analyst`. Custom ids defined in `#codeNarration.customPersonas#` are also accepted. Unknown ids fall back to `default`.

codeNarration.customPersonas.markdownDescription: User-defined personas, keyed by id. Each value may set `displayName`, `description`, and prompt overrides: `preamble` (composed onto the built-in output rules) or full overrides via `systemPrompt`, `symbolSystemPrompt`, `diffSystemPrompt`, `treeSummarySystemPrompt`, `treeFileDiffSystemPrompt`. Ids must be 1-64 chars (letters, digits, `-`, `_`) and cannot collide with built-in ids. Prompt strings are capped at 8000 chars each. Invalid entries are skipped at load time with a warning.

displayName.description: User-visible name shown in the persona quick-pick.

description.description: Short description shown as quick-pick detail.

preamble.description: Lens sentence prepended to the built-in base prompts for any slot not overridden below. Lets you extend the default output rules without re-specifying them.

systemPrompt.description: Full override for whole-file narration. Skip to inherit the base prompt (optionally with `preamble`).

treeSummarySystemPrompt.description: Full override for the tree-diff summary section.

treeFileDiffSystemPrompt.description: Full override for per-file tree-diff narration.

codeNarration.anthropic.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens the Anthropic model may emit for a single narration request. Raise this when long symbols or diffs are getting silently cut off (a truncation marker will appear in the section); lower it to cap spend. Should not exceed the selected model's documented max_tokens (Sonnet 4.6: 64k, Opus 4.7: 32k, Haiku 4.5: 8k).

codeNarration.diffBase.description: Git ref to diff against in diff narration mode.

codeNarration.narrateOnSave.description: Re-narrate the file when it is saved, if the narration pane is open and showing that file.

codeNarration.followActiveEditor.description: When the narration pane is open in file mode, retarget it to follow the active text editor as focus moves between files. Diff and tree-diff targets remain pinned regardless of this setting.

codeNarration.symbolConcurrency.description: Maximum number of language model calls to run in parallel when narrating a symbol-aware file.

enumDescriptions: Recurse into child symbols for container-heavy languages (C#, Java, C/C++, Kotlin, Swift, Scala, F#, VB, Objective-C/C++); stay top-level only for others.
Always narrate each child symbol (e.g., methods inside a class) as its own section.
Never recurse; narrate only top-level symbols.
codeNarration.recurseSymbols.description: Whether to narrate child symbols as their own sections. Legacy boolean values (true/false) are still honored as 'always'/'never'.

codeNarration.maxPromptTokens.description: Token budget for a single LLM prompt body. When a symbol's prompt would exceed this, the symbol is split into overlapping line-range sub-chunks, each narrated independently, and the results are merged. Lower this for cheaper calls or to fit smaller context windows; raise it if your model has plenty of context and you want fewer cuts.

codeNarration.streamIdleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum number of milliseconds the language-model stream may go without emitting a chunk before the request is aborted and (where applicable) retried. Guards against hung proxies and stalled SSE connections that would otherwise leave a section pulsing forever. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

codeNarration.speech.enabled.description: Show speech controls in the narration pane and enable text-to-speech using the system's voices (via the Web Speech API).

codeNarration.speech.autoPlay.description: Speak narration sentences automatically as they stream in. Requires codeNarration.speech.enabled.

codeNarration.speech.voice.description: Preferred voice name. Empty uses the system default. Set via the 'Code Narration: Pick Voice' command.

codeNarration.speech.rate.description: Speech rate multiplier (0.5 = half speed, 2.0 = double speed).

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.compile:prod: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
